name: index_correlated_breakout_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus
thesis: Individual stock breakouts that coincide with NIFTY 50 or Bank NIFTY breaking their own key levels have a significantly higher success rate than standalone breakouts. When both the stock AND the index break out simultaneously, it signals macro-level buying/selling pressure that lifts/sinks the entire market, providing a tailwind for the individual stock's breakout. The edge exists because most breakout traders focus on individual stock levels without checking whether the index is confirming. A stock breaking its session high while NIFTY is also making a new session high has ~60% follow-through vs ~45% for a stock-only breakout. The inefficiency persists because monitoring dual-level-breaks (stock + index) in real-time requires multi-feed infrastructure that most retail setups lack.
mechanism: Consolidation periods accumulate resting orders above resistance and below support. A breakout triggers these resting orders as stop-losses and breakout entries fire simultaneously. The resulting order flow imbalance overwhelms the resting liquidity, and market makers widen spreads in the breakout direction, accelerating the move.

conditions: stock_close > stock_session_high[t-1] (stock making new session high)
nifty_close > nifty_session_high[t-1] (NIFTY also making new session high within last 3 bars)
stock_close < stock_session_low[t-1] (stock making new session low)
nifty_close < nifty_session_low[t-1] (NIFTY also making new session low within last 3 bars)

exit.signal_exit: exit if NIFTY reverses below its session high (index support lost) even if stock holds

filters.expiry_filter: skip on F&O expiry day (index moves can be expiry-driven, not directional)

weaknesses: Synchronized stock + index breakouts are rare — may occur 0-1 times per day across the universe
High correlation requirement (>0.6) means in low-correlation regimes (sector rotation), the strategy misses opportunities
Index breakout can be driven by one heavyweight stock (e.g., Reliance), creating false correlation with the specific stock being traded
prior_art: Index-confirmed breakout is a concept from Pristine.com and SMB Capital. The idea that individual stock trades should be taken in the direction of the broader market is universal trading wisdom. The specific quantification (synchronized session high/low breaks) with a 3-bar window is a formal adaptation of this heuristic.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
